      parameters:

          in: query
          name: page
          required: false
          schema:
            default: 1
            minimum: 1
            type: number

          in: query
          name: per_page
          required: false
          schema:
            default: 20
            maximum: 1000
            minimum: 1
            type: number

          in: query

          name: tags
          required: false
          schema:
            default: []
            description: Tag IDs associated with this dashboard.
            items:
              maxLength: 250
              type: string
            maxItems: 100
            type: array
        - description: A tag ID to exclude. Accepts a single tag ID or multiple tag IDs. When multiple are specified, library items matching any of the tag IDs are excluded.
          in: query
          name: excluded_tags
          required: false
          schema:
            default: []
            description: Tag IDs associated with this dashboard.
            items:
              maxLength: 250
              type: string
            maxItems: 100
            type: array
        - description: A tag name to include. Accepts a single tag name or multiple tag names. When multiple are specified, library items matching any of the tag names are included. If the same name is shared by multiple tags, items matching any of those tags are included.
          in: query

          required: false
          schema:
            items:
              type: string
            maxItems: 100
            type: array

        - description: A tag name to exclude. Accepts a single tag name or multiple tag names. When multiple are specified, library items matching any of the tag names are excluded. If the same name is shared by multiple tags, items matching any of those tags are excluded.
          in: query
          name: excluded_tag_names
          required: false
          schema:
            items:
              type: string
            maxItems: 100
            type: array
            x-state: Generally available; added in 9.6.0

The dashboard and the alert rule both exist, and the rule is enabled. I didn't open the dashboard in Kibana. Both create calls succeeded, but I haven't checked that the panels render or that the rule has run.

**Fields:** the data view `kibana_sample_data_logs` has `timestamp`, `response.keyword` (the HTTP status), `bytes`, `clientip`, `request.keyword`, `url.keyword`, `extension.keyword`, `geo.src`, `geo.dest`, `machine.os.keyword`, `agent.keyword`, `host.keyword` and `tags.keyword`.

**Dashboard:** "EFF-97c781bb Web logs overview" (id `705f1d91-044e-4fc8-88f4-68d518982d09`) has five panels:
- A metric showing total requests.
- A metric showing average bytes.
- A metric showing unique clients, counted on `clientip`.
- A line chart of requests over time.
- A bar chart of requests by response code.

**Rule:** "EFF-97c781bb 5xx spike" (id `6e38f2e8-ad9e-42f5-89d7-6c8db86cc0cf`) is an Elasticsearch query rule.
- It runs every minute.
- It counts documents matching the KQL query `response.keyword:5*` over the last 5 minutes.
- It fires when that count is above 10.
- It has no actions attached, so it will raise alerts in Kibana but won't send any notification.

status_detail: dashboard + 5xx spike rule created; not yet verified
